newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Avis Yugoslavia to join Amadeus system - agency.
newsitem.headline: Avis Yugoslavia to join Amadeus system - agency.

text.p: Yugoslavia's Avis rent-a-car plans to join the global reservation system Amadeus, Yugoslav News Agency Tanjug reported on Tuesday.
"Our clients will be able to reserve cars at over 350,000 terminals in the world when we join the Amadeus system," Avis Yugoslavia director Djordje Bobic was quoted as saying.
It is also necessary to be part of the Avis Wizard system through which cars are rented, commissions calculated and invoicing done to make use of Amadeus, Bobic said.
Domestic tourist organisations will be able to sell rent-a-car services throughout the world through Avis Yugoslavia, he said.
Avis director for Scandinavia, Eastern and Central Europe Olav Hommerstad said he expected the Yugoslav office to show good business results.
